lines.en: label bathhouse25:
scene iosidesbath1
: Hah...Okay. I’m done working for today. You can take over now, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 哈……好了。我今天的工作干完了。现在交给你了，Sensei。

lines.en: : But I don’t know the first thing about running a bathhouse.
lines.zh: : 可我对经营澡堂一窍不通。

lines.en: : It’s easy. Just do what I do.
lines.zh: : 很简单。照我做的做就行。

lines.en: : You mean complain and talk down on myself while watching baseball and drinking soda?
lines.zh: : 你是说一边看棒球喝汽水，一边抱怨和自我贬低？

lines.en: scene iosidesbath2
: Yeah. Just make sure you clean the floors every once in a while and take money whenever someone tries to give it to you.
lines.zh: : 对。只要偶尔拖拖地，有人给你钱就收下。

lines.en: I find myself at the bathhouse- which is apparently now my second workplace.
lines.zh: 我发现自己身在澡堂——这里显然已经成了我的第二工作场所。

lines.en: I came here in an attempt to spend some time alone with Io but, as fate would have it, things haven’t really worked out that way thus far.
lines.zh: 我来这儿本想和 Io 单独待会儿，可事与愿违，到目前为止事情完全没往那个方向发展。

lines.en: The second school dorm building (You know, the one where every class {i}but{/i} mine lives) has a busted water heater at the moment, meaning that everyone interested in practicing personal hygiene must come {i}here.{/i}
lines.zh: 第二栋学校宿舍楼（你知道的，除了我们班以外所有班级都住那栋）的热水器这会儿坏了，所以凡是想讲究个人卫生的姑娘都得来{i}这儿{/i}。

lines.en: This is not something I knew until showing up. And I really wish it {i}was{/i} because all of those girls know who I am and I can’t imagine seeing me casually hanging out with Io is a good look for either one of us.
lines.zh: 我来之前并不知道这件事。我真希望我知道，因为那些女孩都认识我，而我无法想象被她们看到我和 Io 若无其事地混在一起，对谁都不好看。

lines.en: Which is why, for today only, I have become an unofficial employee of the bathhouse. Though, only in name so I can tell everyone that there’s an actual reason I’m here.
lines.zh: 所以，仅限今天，我成了澡堂的非正式员工。当然只是名义上的，好让我能跟所有人解释我来这儿的正当理由。

lines.en: When it comes to work, I’ve yet to do anything.
lines.zh: 至于工作，我还什么都没干。

lines.en: : What if we just close early? That’s a thing we should be allowed to do, right?
lines.zh: : 我们要不干脆早点关门？这总该是允许我们做的事吧？

lines.en: : You want to close early on what has quickly become the busiest day we’ve had in years?
lines.zh: : 你想在这么多年以来最忙的一天提前关门？

lines.en: : Kind of, yeah.
lines.zh: : 大概吧，对。

lines.en: : Sounds good to me. Maybe you should just become an actual employee if you’re going to keep coming up with stuff like that?
lines.zh: : 我看行。要是你总能想出这种点子，干脆正式来上班算了？

lines.en: : I’m just applying the same strategy I use at school to this- work less, not hard.
lines.zh: : 我只是把我在学校用的那套策略搬过来——少干活，不必卖力。

lines.en: scene iosidesbath3
: And what an admirable strategy that is, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 这策略可真高尚啊，Sensei。

lines.en: : When you look at the reality of this situation, the bathhouse has already taken in far more cash than normal.
lines.zh: : 从现实来看，澡堂今天赚的钱已经远超平常了。

lines.en: : Which means it should be completely acceptable to cut off that cash flow now in favor of the employees.
lines.zh: : 所以现在为了员工着想掐断这笔进账，应该是完全可以接受的。

lines.en: : Exactly. But also, probably don’t consider starting your own business any time soon.
lines.zh: : 正是。不过，你大概也别急着考虑自己创业。

lines.en: scene iosidesbath4
: So! Now that we’re officially {i}unofficially{/i} closed, what do you wanna do? Ready for a bath yourself?
lines.zh: : 那么！既然我们正式地「{i}非正式{/i}」打烊了，你想干点什么？自己也准备泡个澡？

lines.en: : Are you just saying that because you want to see my penis again?
lines.zh: : 你这么说，只是因为又想看我的阴茎了吧？

lines.en: : Nah. The novelty of your penis has worn off. It’s your ability to appeal to my inner broodiness and the fact that you actually pay attention to me that’s keeping me hooked right now.
lines.zh: : 不。你那根阴茎的新鲜感早过了。现在让我上瘾的，是你对我内心那股阴郁的迎合，还有你居然真的会注意我。

lines.en: : First, the novelty of my penis will never wear off. Second, your broodiness is far from {i}internal.{/i} Third, it’s hard {i}not{/i} paying attention to you when everything about you screams “Pay attention to me.”
lines.zh: : 第一，我那根阴茎的新鲜感永远不会消退。第二，你的阴郁远谈不上「{i}内心{/i}」。第三，你浑身上下都在喊「快看我」，我想不注意都难。

lines.en: : Correction: everything about me screams “Pay attention to me, Sensei.” I couldn’t care less as far as everyone else is concerned.
lines.zh: : 纠正一下：我浑身上下喊的是「快看我，Sensei」。至于别人，我才不在乎。

lines.en: : Yes, you’ve made that quite apparent as well.
lines.zh: : 是啊，这点你也表现得够明显了。

lines.en: scene iosidesbath5
: Oh, welcome! We’re actually closed right-
lines.zh: : 哦，欢迎光临！我们其实已经打——

lines.en: scene iosidesbath6
: Ah! Yuki!
lines.zh: : 啊！Yuki！

lines.en: scene iosidesbath7
: And...some other girl.
lines.zh: : 还有……另一个女的。

lines.en: : Hey! What are you doing here?
lines.zh: : 嘿！你在这儿干什么？

lines.en: : Rockin’ the cradle, that’s what.
lines.zh: : 摇摇篮呗，还能干什么。

lines.en: : I actually work here now.
lines.zh: : 我现在在这儿上班。

lines.en: scene iosidesbath8
: You what?
lines.zh: : 你什么？

lines.en: : Hey, what’s the big deal?! How come you can work {i}here{/i} but not at my bar?
lines.zh: : 嘿，这算什么？！你为什么能在{i}这儿{/i}上班，却不能在我的酒吧上班？

lines.en: : I’m sorry, Sara. It’s the name of it.
lines.zh: : 抱歉，Sara。是名字的问题。

lines.en: : I take offense to that! That’s {i}my{/i} name too!
lines.zh: : 我觉得受到了冒犯！那也是{i}我的{/i}名字！

lines.en: : You actually workin’ here now? What happened to teaching?
lines.zh: : 你真在这儿上班了？那教书呢？

lines.en: : It’s just for today. A bunch of girls from the school are here because of some water issue, so I’m pretending to work here so it doesn't seem weird that I'm hanging out with Io.
lines.zh: : 就今天。学校的一群女孩因为供水问题来了这儿，所以我假装在这儿上班，好让我和 Io 混在一起不那么奇怪。

lines.en: : Once again, I have inconvenienced Sensei in a way that benefits me! Rejoice!
lines.zh: : 我又一次以对自己有利的方式给 Sensei 添了麻烦！欢呼吧！

lines.en: scene iosidesbath9
: Io? The girl behind you?
lines.zh: : Io？你后面那个女孩？

lines.en: : I knew that you spent some of your free time with Sana and Ayane, but I didn’t realize you were going around and doing that with {i}everyone{/i} in your class.
lines.zh: : 我知道你有些空闲时间是和 Sana、Ayane 一起过的，但我不知道你还在和班里的「{i}每一个{/i}」都这么干。

lines.en: : Like I said, rockin’ the cradle. Don’t tell me you’re surprised, Sara.
lines.zh: : 我说过了，摇摇篮。别告诉我你很意外，Sara。

lines.en: scene iosidesbath10
: Well, just don’t go luring them into a false state of security before impregnating them and leaving them to fend for themselves while you run off with somebody else.
lines.zh: : 好吧，只要别把她们哄到一种虚假的安全感里，再把人搞大肚子、丢下她们自生自灭，自己跑去跟别人双宿双飞就行。

lines.en: : Damn. If I knew you were bringin’ this much baggage, I would’ve suggested stopping at one of those coin lockers on the way over here.
lines.zh: : 靠。早知道你带了这么多心理包袱，我就建议在来的路上先停一下那些投币储物柜了。

lines.en: scene iosidesbath11
: I’m over it. And hi, Io. I’m Sara.
lines.zh: : 我早翻篇了。还有，你好，Io。我是 Sara。

lines.en: : I know I might look 20, but I’m actually Sana’s mom.
lines.zh: : 我知道我看着像 20 岁，但我其实是 Sana 的妈妈。

lines.en: : Sana? Do we have somebody in class with that name?
lines.zh: : Sana？我们班有叫这个名字的人吗？

lines.en: : Ignore her. She ain’t the type to really make friends.
lines.zh: : 别理她。她不是那种会交朋友的人。

lines.en: : That’s fine. Neither is my daughter.
lines.zh: : 没关系。我女儿也不是。

lines.en: scene black
Yuki pulls a wad of crumpled up bills out of her pocket before trying to hand them over to Io, only to have them shoved back in her face seconds later.
lines.zh: Yuki 从口袋里掏出一沓皱巴巴的钞票想递给 Io，几秒钟后就被塞回了她脸上。

lines.en: And seeing as none of the girls from the “main” dorm knew about the men’s side of the bath being open to the highest bidder, it’s currently unoccupied.
lines.zh: 由于「主」宿舍的女孩们都不知道男汤是价高者得的，那边现在空着。

lines.en: Which means that, just moments from now, Sara and Yuki will be naked together.
lines.zh: 也就是说，再过一会儿，Sara 和 Yuki 就要一起赤诚相见了。

lines.en: I like this and I want to participate.
lines.zh: 我喜欢这个，我也想参与。

lines.en: scene iosidesbath12
However, a small green roadblock stands in my way.
lines.zh: 然而，一个绿色的小路障挡在我面前。

lines.en: : You guys can take the men’s side. But, just so you know, I’m closing the place up because Sensei thinks it would be best for business if the business part just...stopped.
lines.zh: : 你们可以去男汤那边。不过先说好，我要打烊了，因为 Sensei 认为对生意最好的做法就是让「生意」这部分……停下来。

lines.en: : That is not what I said. But also, yes.
lines.zh: : 我不是这么说的。不过，也对。

lines.en: : Fine by me. Two’s already a crowd when it comes to shit like this.
lines.zh: : 我没意见。这种事两个人就已经够挤了。

lines.en: : Yuki is just embarrassed because it’s the first time she’ll be seeing my naked body.
lines.zh: : Yuki 只是不好意思，因为这是她第一次看到我的裸体。

lines.en: : Yeah, I wasn’t talking to you.
lines.zh: : 嗯，我不是在跟你说话。

lines.en: scene iosidesbath13
: Wow. Teenagers are really hard to approach now, huh?
lines.zh: : 哇。现在的青少年真难接近啊，是吧？

lines.en: : Ay, don’t be a bitch. Sara’s good people. She’s the one I’ve been working for.
lines.zh: : 哎，别这么刻薄。Sara 是个好人。我就是在给她打工。

lines.en: scene iosidesbath14
: Ahh...so this is what it means to have protection from the Yakuza.
lines.zh: : 啊……这就是被山口组罩着的感觉吧。

lines.en: : For the last time, I ain’t Yakuza anymore. I’m just Yuki now.
lines.zh: : 我都说最后一次了，我不是山口组了。我现在只是 Yuki。

lines.en: : Good. Stay “Just Yuki.” I like Yuki. This other one, I’m still not sure about.
lines.zh: : 很好。就当「只是 Yuki」吧。我喜欢 Yuki。至于另一位，我还不确定。

lines.en: scene iosidesbath15
: Ooh! Here’s an idea! What if we all took a bath together?!
lines.zh: : 哦！我有个主意！要不我们一起泡澡吧？！

lines.en: : Strike that. I’ve decided I don’t like her.
lines.zh: : 收回刚才那句。我决定了，我不喜欢她。

lines.en: : Were you not listenin’ when I just said two’s already a crowd? Three sounds even worse.
lines.zh: : 你没听见我刚说两个人就已经够挤了吗？三个听起来更糟。

lines.en: : Except it wouldn’t be three. It would be four with Sensei.
lines.zh: : 可不会是三个。加上 Sensei 就是四个。

lines.en: scene iosidesbath16
: Uhh...
: Ain’t you supposed to like, {i}not{/i} encourage the whole cradle rockin’ thing? Io’s still in high school.
lines.zh: : 你不是应该「不」鼓励这种摇摇篮的事吗？Io 还在上高中呢。

lines.en: : I’m just not going to say anything and let Sara field this one herself as I don’t want to get in trouble.
lines.zh: : 我什么都不说，让 Sara 自己应付，因为我不想惹麻烦。

lines.en: : Hey, Yuki and I are just here to relax. I don’t see an issue with getting into the bath with swimsuits on. Especially since doing that would let Sensei join in on the fun as well.
lines.zh: : 嘿，Yuki 和我只是来放松的。我觉得穿着泳衣下池子没什么问题。尤其是那样 Sensei 也能一起玩。

lines.en: I’m suddenly less interested, but this is still a thing I want to participate in.
lines.zh: 我突然没那么感兴趣了，但这仍然是我想要参与的事。

lines.en: : Why not just leave him out of this? Ain't no reason he has to come in there with us.
lines.zh: : 为什么不干脆把他排除在外？他没有理由非得跟我们进去。

lines.en: I also don't like Yuki anymore.
lines.zh: 我也不喜欢 Yuki 了。

lines.en: : Obviously because he's our friend and we don't want him to be lonely.
lines.zh: : 显然因为他是我们的朋友，我们不想让他孤单。

lines.en: : I mean...I guess wearin' swimsuits would solve the whole high school nudity problem, but it ain’t like either of us brought shit like that, right?
lines.zh: : 我是说……穿泳衣确实能解决高中生裸体的问题，可我们俩都没带那种东西吧？

lines.en: : I don’t even think I own a swimsuit.
lines.zh: : 我觉得我连泳衣都没有。

lines.en: scene iosidesbath17
: Do you have any we could borrow, Io? There have to be some, like...community swimsuits, right?
lines.zh: : 你有能借我们的吗，Io？总该有什么……公用的泳衣吧？

lines.en: : Towels, yeah...swimsuits? That’s...not really a thing anyone has ever asked for before.
lines.zh: : 毛巾有……泳衣？这……以前从来没人要过这个。

lines.en: : I guess I could raid my aunt’s stuff and see if she has anything, but...
lines.zh: : 我倒是可以去翻翻我阿姨的东西，看她有没有，可是……

lines.en: : Sorry, why am I even being included in this again?
lines.zh: : 抱歉，为什么我又被算进来了？

lines.en: : Aren’t you closing up? I figured you’d want to unwind after a hard day of work.
lines.zh: : 你不是要打烊吗？我想辛苦工作一天之后，你大概也想放松一下。

lines.en: : That does sound pretty relaxing. Working at a bathhouse is a lot more exhausting than I thought.
lines.zh: : 听起来确实挺放松的。在澡堂工作比我想的要累多了。

lines.en: scene iosidesbath18
: You didn’t even do anything...
lines.zh: : 你明明什么都没干……

lines.en: : You really okay with this idea?
lines.zh: : 你真的没问题？

lines.en: : I mean...I don’t see anything {i}technically{/i} wrong with it so long as both Io and I are covered up. But I do think it’s kind of weird no matter how you look at it since this is a bathhouse and not a pool.
lines.zh: : 我是说……只要我和 Io 都穿着衣服，我「{i}技术上{/i}」看不出有什么问题。不过不管怎么看，这都挺奇怪的，毕竟这是澡堂不是游泳池。

lines.en: : What is a bathhouse if not a hot pool that people bathe in?
lines.zh: : 澡堂不就是给人泡的热水池子吗？

lines.en: : You should write a book.
lines.zh: : 你该去写本书。

lines.en: scene iosidesbath19
: I’ll, uhh...go check upstairs. But only because I do think that getting in the water sounds relaxing right now and I’m afraid that Sensei would still join you if I refused.
lines.zh: : 我，呃……上楼去看看。不过只是因为我也觉得现在下水挺放松的，而且我怕我要是拒绝，Sensei 还是会跟你们一起进去。

lines.en: I would have.
lines.zh: 我确实会的。

lines.en: : You sure about this? I know you’re weird around girls who are like, actual girls and not {i}me.{/i}
lines.zh: : 你确定吗？我知道你在真正的「女孩」面前会不自在，不像在「{i}我{/i}」面前。

lines.en: : You said she’s “good people,” so I’m trusting your word on this. But if she annoys me, which I feel like she is going to, I will not hesitate to let her know.
lines.zh: : 你说她「是个好人」，所以我相信你的话。不过如果她惹烦我——我觉得她肯定会——我会毫不犹豫地让她知道。

lines.en: : Thanks, Io. I’m sure you’ll have just as much fun as the rest of us.
lines.zh: : 谢谢，Io。我相信你会和我们其他人一样玩得开心的。

lines.en: : Yeah, it’s easy to say things like that when you don’t know me.
lines.zh: : 是啊，你不了解我的时候，说这种话当然容易。

lines.en: : Anyway...whatever. You two can just go wait in the dressing room while I flip the sign. Sensei can stay out here.
lines.zh: : 总之……算了。你们俩去更衣室等着，我去翻牌子。Sensei 留在外面。

lines.en: : I don’t want people seeing you guys standing around and assuming we’re still open. And everybody else has already paid, so...
lines.zh: : 我不想让别人看见你们站在这儿，以为我们还在营业。而且其他人也都付过钱了，所以……

lines.en: : Yeah. Bye.
lines.zh: : 嗯。拜拜。

lines.en: : And don’t do anything weird while I’m gone. The cameras store footage for up to 24 hours, so I’ll know.
lines.zh: : 还有，我不在的时候别干奇怪的事。摄像头会存 24 小时，我会知道的。

lines.en: scene iosidesbath20
: Cameras?
lines.zh: : 摄像头？

lines.en: : Is that even legal?
lines.zh: : 那合法吗？

lines.en: : I ain’t worried. Chances are somebody out there’s already got footage of me. Doubt a little more would hurt at all.
lines.zh: : 我不担心。外面大概早就有我的录像了。再多一点也无所谓。

lines.en: scene black
I decide to do as I'm told and wait in the lobby while Sara and Yuki retreat into the men’s dressing room.
lines.zh: 我决定照她说的做，在大厅里等着，Sara 和 Yuki 则退进男更衣室。

lines.en: This lasts about five minutes before Sara, wearing nothing but a towel, walks back out into the lobby and forcibly pulls me away from my monthly good deed.
lines.zh: 这状态持续了大约五分钟，随后 Sara 身上只裹着一条毛巾走回大厅，强行把我从我本月的好人好事里拽走。

lines.en: And while it wouldn’t be right of me to complain about an attractive grown woman’s desire to be closer to me while she’s wearing next to nothing, I can’t imagine Io will be happy to see me in there with them.
lines.zh: 虽然抱怨一个有魅力的成年女性在几乎一丝不挂时想离我更近不太合适，但我无法想象 Io 看到我和她们在里面会高兴。

lines.en: scene iosidesbath21
: If I didn’t already know this was going to happen and wasn’t so dependent on your affection, I’d be really frustrated with you right now, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 如果我不是早就知道会变成这样、又这么依赖你的宠爱，我现在会对你非常火大，Sensei。

lines.en: : I tried to listen. Sara just wasn’t having it.
lines.zh: : 我试着听话了。Sara 就是不依。

lines.en: scene iosidesbath22
: Why am I not surprised?
lines.zh: : 我为什么一点也不意外？

lines.en: : So, did you find anything?
lines.zh: : 那么，找到什么了吗？

lines.en: : Unless you want to try wearing one of {i}my{/i} swimsuits, no. I did not.
lines.zh: : 除非你想试试穿「{i}我的{/i}」泳衣，否则没有。我没找到。

lines.en: : Well, I did find a pair of shorts for Sensei. But it looks like you are going to have to wear your towel if you still want to carry through with this “safe for work bath time extravaganza.”
lines.zh: : 我倒是给 Sensei 找了条短裤。不过看来你要是想继续这场「适合工作场合的泡澡狂欢」，还是得裹着你的毛巾。

lines.en: : That or Sensei and I can just come in after you two are done and-
lines.zh: : 要不我和 Sensei 等你们俩泡完再进——

lines.en: scene iosidesbath23
: Oh no! My towel has fallen off! How could this have happened?!
lines.zh: : 哦不！我的毛巾掉了！怎么会这样？！

lines.en: : Yo.
: Yeah, saw that coming.
lines.zh: : 是啊，早料到了。

lines.en: scene iosidesbath24
if sarasex == False:
: And you can’t even run away this time...
lines.zh: : 而且这次你可跑不掉了……

lines.en: else:
: {i}Oh no. Whatever will I do now that Sensei has seen me naked?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}哦不。Sensei 看到了我的裸体，我该怎么办呢？{/i}

lines.en: : You realize you’re just going to make this harder for me, right?
lines.zh: : 你知道你只会让我更难办，对吧？

lines.en: : That’s exactly what I want.
lines.zh: : 这正是我想要的。

lines.en: : Hah...
scene iosidesbath25
: If you can’t beat ‘em, join ‘em.
lines.zh: : 打不过就加入。

lines.en: : Woo! Go Yuki! Take it off!
lines.zh: : 呜哦！Yuki 加油！脱掉！

lines.en: : Uhh...hold on. Sensei’s still here. Shouldn’t you, like...maybe {i}not{/i} strip in front of him?
lines.zh: : 呃……等等。Sensei 还在这儿呢。你们是不是该……「别」在他面前脱？

lines.en: : I mean, {i}technically,{/i} this is {i}his{/i} side of the bath, isn’t it?
lines.zh: : 「{i}技术上{/i}」说，这本来就是「{i}他{/i}」那边的浴池，不是吗？

lines.en: : Technically, yeah. But-
lines.zh: : 技术上说是，可是——

lines.en: scene iosidesbath26
: Can all this talkin’ stop already? I’m fucking tired.
lines.zh: : 能不能别他妈废话了？我累死了。

lines.en: : Sensei! Look away! There are too many boobs in here all of a sudden!
lines.zh: : Sensei！别看！突然间这里的奶子太多了！

lines.en: : And, for the first time in my life, I’m the biggest out of everyone.
lines.zh: : 而且，我这辈子头一回是所有人里最大的。

lines.en: scene iosidesbath27
: You tryin’ to fuckin’ start something?
lines.zh: : 你想他妈挑事吗？

lines.en: : Of course not! After you, Yuki. We wouldn’t want to stand here and intrude on Sensei’s personal space while {i}he{/i} gets undressed, would we?
lines.zh: : 当然不是！您先请，Yuki。我们可不想站在这儿，在「{i}他{/i}」脱衣服的时候侵犯 Sensei 的个人空间，对吧？

lines.en: scene iosidesbath28
: If only there wasn’t a student here...Then maybe he wouldn’t need those shorts at all.
lines.zh: : 要是没有学生在这儿就好了……那他大概连那条短裤都不用穿。

lines.en: : I’ve seen him naked plenty of times! We have cameras, remember?! What I {i}haven’t{/i} seen is him naked with-
lines.zh: : 他光着的样子我见得多了！我们有摄像头，记得吗？！我{i}没{/i}见过的是他和——一起光着……

lines.en: : Well...actually there was one time. But nothing happened then and...and...
lines.zh: : 嗯……其实有一次。可那次什么也没发生，而且……而且……

lines.en: : Everybody just get in the fucking water, already!
lines.zh: : 你们都他妈赶紧下水吧！

lines.en: scene black
Io pushes Sara and Yuki out of the room and I get changed faster than I’ve ever gotten changed before.
lines.zh: Io 把 Sara 和 Yuki 推出房间，我以这辈子最快的速度换好衣服。

lines.en: And while it’s unfortunate that both Io and I have to keep our clothes on to preserve my image as an upstanding member of society, I {i}do{/i} understand it.
lines.zh: 虽然很遗憾，为了维护我作为社会良民的形象，我和 Io 都得穿着衣服，但我{i}确实{/i}理解。

lines.en: I’m sure that both Sara and Yuki have their...{i}suspicions,{/i} but so long as those remain nothing more than {i}suspicions,{/i} everything will be okay.
lines.zh: 我敢肯定 Sara 和 Yuki 都有她们的「{i}怀疑{/i}」，但只要那些仅仅是「{i}怀疑{/i}」，一切就都还好。

lines.en: We can all take solace in the fact that it’s easy to ignore things you don’t want to be true. But it’s a lot harder to accept them when they are.
lines.zh: 我们都能从这一点上得到安慰：忽略你不愿相信的事很容易。可当它们成真时，接受起来就难得多。

lines.en: scene iosidesbath29
For the time being, the only thing that {i}is{/i} true in all of our minds is that we’re here willingly.
lines.zh: 眼下，在所有人的脑海里唯一「确凿」的事，就是我们都是自愿在这里的。

lines.en: Some less willing than others, sure...but it’s all agreed upon even when certain aspects of that agreement have been bent and twisted out of shape.
lines.zh: 当然，有些人没那么情愿……但即便这份协议的某些部分已经被掰弯、扭曲，它依然是被一致同意的。

lines.en: This is fine because nothing is going to happen tonight.
lines.zh: 这没关系，因为今晚什么都不会发生。

lines.en: And if anything does happen tonight, I’m sure {i}that{/i} would be agreed upon as well.
lines.zh: 而如果今晚真发生了什么，我相信那也会是大家一致同意的。

lines.en: Part of me hopes something does, for my true colors would appear far less vibrant amidst the contents of several other boxes of crayons being poured into one big pile.
lines.zh: 我有一部分希望真发生点什么，因为在好几盒蜡笔倒成一堆的时候，我的真面目会显得不那么鲜艳。

lines.en: That’s just wishful thinking, though.
lines.zh: 不过那只是痴心妄想。

lines.en: I know my colors will always stand out.
lines.zh: 我知道我的颜色永远会跳出来。

lines.en: They’re just too dark to properly blend in with the others.
lines.zh: 它们太暗，没法好好和别的颜色融在一起。

lines.en: : So, Io...{i}you’re{/i} the girl who’s always complimenting Yuki on her back tattoo, right? Did you know that {i}I{/i} have tattoos as well?
lines.zh: : 那么，Io……你{i}就是{/i}那个总夸 Yuki 背上纹身的女孩吧？你知道{i}我{/i}也有纹身吗？

lines.en: : Yes. I found that out the moment you decided it was acceptable to strip down to nothing right in front of my teacher.
lines.zh: : 知道。就在你决定在我老师面前脱得一丝不挂的那一刻，我就知道了。

lines.en: scene iosidesbath30
: Want to take a closer look? Here. I got this one when I was only 17 and-
lines.zh: : 想凑近看看吗？来。这个是我 17 岁的时候纹的，而且——

lines.en: : Sit down! Jesus! I don’t want a closer look!
lines.zh: : 坐下！天啊！我不想凑近看！

lines.en: : How about you, Sensei? Want to touch it?
lines.zh: : 你呢，Sensei？想摸摸吗？

lines.en: : Uhh...
: No one wants to see your basic ass butterfly tattoo, Sara. There are like a trillion other girls who have the same exact shit in the same exact spot.
lines.zh: : 没人想看你那个烂大街的蝴蝶纹身，Sara。大概有一万亿个女孩在同一个位置纹了一模一样的东西。

lines.en: scene iosidesbath31
: Well excuse me for not having the cool Yakuza connections required to get a huge dragon tattooed across my back.
lines.zh: : 抱歉啊，我没有酷炫的山口组人脉，没法在后背纹一条巨龙。

lines.en: : I like my butterfly and I am proud of it.
lines.zh: : 我喜欢我的蝴蝶，我为此骄傲。

lines.en: : You don’t {i}need{/i} Yakuza connections to get shit like that. Just makes it cheaper. Got mine done for free.
lines.zh: : 纹那种东西根本「{i}不需要{/i}」山口组人脉。只是便宜点而已。我的就是免费纹的。

lines.en: : Wish I could get it finished, though. Wound up abandoning that lifestyle before I could get it colored in. Might’ve hung around a little while longer if I thought of it back then.
lines.zh: : 可惜没能纹完。我在上色之前就脱离那种生活了。要是当时想到这一点，我大概会多混一阵子。

lines.en: : Ain’t no way I can afford that shit now. Not without crawlin’ back to Yumi’s prick of a dad.
lines.zh: : 现在我可纹不起那玩意儿了。除非爬回去找 Yumi 那个混蛋老爹。

lines.en: scene iosidesbath32
: Oh, speaking of which- you hear anything about her lately?
lines.zh: : 哦，说到这个——你最近有她的消息吗？

lines.en: : Yumi? I...haven’t seen her around. Why?
lines.zh: : Yumi？我……没怎么见过她。怎么了？

lines.en: : Got a call the other day from some chick I used to ride with. Dude she’s seein’s the captain of one of the Yamaguchi branches.
lines.zh: : 前几天我以前一起混的一个姐妹给我打了个电话。她现在傍上的那男的是山口组某个分部的头目。

lines.en: : Told me Yumi showed up back at home the other day. First time in like a year.
lines.zh: : 她跟我说 Yumi 前几天回老家了。差不多一年来头一回。

lines.en: : Probably just needs money or some shit. But I figured you might know something about it.
lines.zh: : 大概只是需要钱什么的。不过我想你可能知道点情况。

lines.en: : I wonder if it has anything to do with the fight?
lines.zh: : 会不会和那场打架有关？

lines.en: scene iosidesbath33
: Fight?
lines.zh: : 打架？

lines.en: : Yumi kicked some girl’s ass in school the other day and hasn’t shown up ever since. It was brutal. She was unconscious and everything.
lines.zh: : Yumi 前几天在学校把某个女孩揍了一顿，之后就再没露面。特别惨。那人都被打昏了。

lines.en: scene iosidesbath34
: Get the fuck out of here. Did she really? No shit?
lines.zh: : 你他妈别逗我。她真干了吗？不是开玩笑？

lines.en: : Why do you look so proud? If Sana got into a fight, I’d be worried sick.
lines.zh: : 你干嘛一脸骄傲？要是 Sana 打架，我会担心死的。

lines.en: : Sana’s like 50lbs soaking wet. Course you’d be worried. Yumi’s got the blood of a fuckin’ warrior. ‘Bout time she’s gotten to actually show it off.
lines.zh: : Sana 湿透了也就五十磅。你当然会担心。Yumi 骨子里流着一个战士的血。是时候让她真正显露出来了。

lines.en: : How’s the girl she fucked up? Can she walk?
lines.zh: : 被她揍的那个女孩怎么样了？还能走路吗？

lines.en: : She had two black eyes for a while, but she’s pretty much back to normal now.
lines.zh: : 她黑了两只眼睛一阵子，不过现在基本恢复正常了。

lines.en: scene iosidesbath35
: Damn. Best news I’ve heard all week. And here I was thinking I wouldn’t be able to relax with all these extra bodies around.
lines.zh: : 靠。这是我一星期以来听到的最好的消息。我本来还以为有这么多人在，我放松不了呢。

lines.en: : You really haven’t heard anything, Sensei? Not even from the principal?
lines.zh: : 你真的一点消息都没听说吗，Sensei？连校长那儿都没有？

lines.en: : Nothing that everyone else doesn’t already know.
lines.zh: : 没有别人不知道的东西。

lines.en: : Crazy. That whole situation was weird. Like, Yumi’s a dick and all, but I don’t think she’s the type to just beat the shit out of somebody for no good reason.
lines.zh: : 真离谱。整件事都很怪。Yumi 是个混蛋没错，可我不觉得她是那种无缘无故就把人往死里打的人。

lines.en: : Nodoka had to have done something, right? What do you think it could be?
lines.zh: : Nodoka 肯定做了什么吧？你觉得会是什么？

lines.en: : Who the fuck cares? My girl won and that’s all that matters.
lines.zh: : 谁他妈在乎？我闺女赢了，这才是最重要的。

lines.en: : Haven’t been this proud since I found out she was runnin’ her own business.
lines.zh: : 自从知道她自己在做生意之后，我就没这么骄傲过了。

lines.en: : Lucky. I feel bad just asking Sana to {i}show up{/i} at mine.
lines.zh: : 真幸运。我光是让 Sana「{i}露个面{/i}」去我店里都不好意思开口。

lines.en: : Yeah, well your daughter’s a puss. Just like her mom with that basic ass butterfly tattoo.
lines.zh: : 是啊，你女儿是个怂包。跟她妈一样，还有那个烂大街的蝴蝶纹身。

lines.en: scene iosidesbath36
: Say one more bad thing about my butterfly and I will come over there and shut you up myself!
lines.zh: : 你再敢说我蝴蝶一句坏话，我就过去亲手让你闭嘴！

lines.en: scene black
Once more, I narrowly avoid having to figure out how to speak on the Nodoka issue as the conversation quickly devolves into both Yuki and Io mocking Sara for the next ten minutes.
lines.zh: 又一次，我险险避开了必须就 Nodoka 的事发言的窘境——接下来的十分钟，对话迅速退化成 Yuki 和 Io 一起嘲笑 Sara。

lines.en: Eventually, Sara {i}does{/i} get up to try and silence Yuki, but is promptly shoved underwater and forced to submit.
lines.zh: 最后 Sara {i}真的{/i}站起来想让 Yuki 闭嘴，却立刻被按进水里、被迫屈服。

lines.en: It’s around this time that Io moves closer to me and attempts to grab my hand.
lines.zh: 大约就在这个时候，Io 靠近我，试图抓住我的手。

lines.en: And even though it all happens underwater, the idea of doing something like that beside two adults is enough to dissuade me from carrying through with it.
lines.zh: 尽管一切都发生在水下，但在两个成年人身边做这种事的念头，足以让我打消念头。

lines.en: And yet she does not relent.
lines.zh: 可她并没有放弃。

lines.en: Each moment that the eyes are not on us is another opportunity for her to bash me over the head with her affection.
lines.zh: 只要没人看着我们，她就又多一次机会用她的爱意敲我的头。

lines.en: But it’s affection I can only accept behind closed doors.
lines.zh: 但那份爱意，我只能在门后接受。

lines.en: When we’re out in the open-
lines.zh: 当我们身处公开场合——

lines.en: It’s better off if I pretend that it just doesn’t exist.
lines.zh: 最好还是假装它根本不存在。
